spec2def(odbccp32i.cpl odbccp32.spec)

# odbccp32i.cpl is all Rust (odbccp32i-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/odbccp32i-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# odbccp32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/odbccp32i-rust/src/odbccp32i/odbccp32.rs)
add_cargo_module(odbccp32i odbccp32i-cargo odbccp32i.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE odbccp32i-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
